findings.label: Top padding deviation
findings.finding: <main> keeps pt-6 (24px) above the .page-container whose spec'd top padding is 0, so content starts 24px below the literal '0 32px 48px 32px'. Applied uniformly across all routes via the shared shell, so it does not reintroduce per-view divergence.
findings.action: Leave as-is (uniform, arguably desirable) or drop pt-6 from <main> for a strict spec match.

findings.label: Dice Roller has no view to standardize
findings.finding: Requirement #1 lists 'Dice Roller' as a main view, but there is no /dice route or DiceRollerView; the nav tile links to /sessions and dice lives inside session views. Nothing in the diff can standardize a non-existent view.
findings.action: Confirm the spec item is obsolete; no code change needed in this diff.

findings.label: sessions index pulled into plain-background set
findings.finding: plainBackgroundRoutes includes 'sessions' (the /sessions index) in addition to 'join-session'. Harmless since /sessions renders JoinSessionView and only gets a solid #0a0a1a fill, but it is slightly beyond the named Join Session scope.

findings.label: AI Settings hero subtitle trimmed
findings.finding: Moving the AI Settings title/subtitle into the shared .app-hero overlay dropped the 'API keys are stored server-side only and never sent to the browser' reassurance sentence from the subtitle. Cosmetic copy change, not a layout issue.
findings.action: Restore the sentence elsewhere on the page if that reassurance is still wanted; otherwise ignore.
